title: Collapse of AMOC ocean current may already be locked in
description: The fate of the Atlantic Ocean current that keeps Europe’s climate warm depends on our carbon emissions and the rate of ice melt from Greenland, but there is a chance that a shutdown is already inevitable
author: Chris Simms

title: Human brains may have got bigger for no particular reason
description: Our brains are large compared with other animals, so it is tempting to assume there was an evolutionary advantage to them – but that may not be true at all
author: Michael Marshall

title: Can the biggest problems in AI be solved by philosophy?
description: AI companies are hiring philosophy graduates to help them understand the nature of consciousness, whether it can be replicated and how their systems can be made better and more reliable
author: Matthew Sparkes

title: ‘Hobbit’ hominins scavenged meat left over by Komodo dragons
description: An experiment that involved feeding a dead goat to a Komodo dragon as well as an analysis of thousands of ancient bones suggests that Homo floresiensis was neither a skilled hunter of big game nor a master of fire
author: James Woodford

title: A volcano has erupted remnants of Earth's primordial magma ocean
description: Earth was once covered by a global magma ocean, which later cooled and crystallised – now traces of this primordial event have been found in magma from a young volcano in the Indian Ocean
author: Christa Lesté-Lasserre

title: Audacious mission to rescue NASA's falling telescope has launched
description: NASA’s Swift space telescope is reaching the end of its two-decade run in orbit – unless a satellite launched on 3 July can give it a lifesaving boost
author: Leah Crane
